assessments.status: main-agent read-only capture and per-table AML analysis; this page author did not rerun
assessments.statement: TPD0 _INI sets I2C address 0x2c and HID descriptor address 0x20; GPIO/IRQ are dynamically evaluated via GNUM(GPDI)/INUM(GPDI), so 0x0000 resource-template placeholders are not real pin values. TPL0 resource methods are supplied by SSDT17 (INTTPL).

assessments.statement: OCLP 3.0.0-rc.3 contains a Tahoe AppleHDA restore patch for its supported Mac models; it is not evidence of G2 Hackintosh support.
Fork claims Tahoe native Wi-Fi; its alpha release asks for hardware validation. AX201/G2-specific Tahoe behavior remains unverified.
